About me

Calm is a skill you can train.

I grew up learning to look around me, and as an adult I turned that habit into a method. I teach you to spot signals, create distance, use your voice and leave in time. The best defence is usually the one that avoids the confrontation. I work with your real body and your real life, at your pace, so you walk more calmly and decide clearly.

The 4 pillars

  • 1 · ObserveKnow what is normal somewhere so you notice what changes.
  • 2 · AvoidChoose routes, timings and distances that give you room.
  • 3 · Set limitsFirm voice, short phrases and a steady stance.
  • 4 · EscapeAlways have a way out. You protect yourself so you can leave.

Safety for preppers

  • Getting homeShoes, water and a plan if transport and networks fail.
  • Your bagDiscreet, light and without advertising what is inside.

Frequently asked questions

Do I need to be fit?

No. We start with observing, avoiding and using your voice, and adapt the physical part.

From what age?

Adult workshops are 18+. Family sessions take place with a responsible adult present.

I have an injury

Check with your doctor first and tell me: we adapt or swap exercises.

Are weapons used?

No. The work is prevention, boundaries and escape.

What does the law say?

Self-defence has conditions that vary by country. Check local rules or ask a lawyer.

How much and how long?

It depends on the programme. You get price and schedule before we start.
